description: An upside down text generator — flip writing over, and flip it back again. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

direction.description: Which way to translate. "auto" turns upside-down text back the right way up and flips anything else; "flip" and "unflip" force one direction.

text.description: The text to turn upside down, or upside-down text to turn back the right way up.

name: upside_down_text
title: Upside Down Text
